title: CORI housing screening rules (803 CMR 5.00)
requirement: Landlords, property managers, real estate agents and public housing authorities may request CORI on a housing applicant only as the final step in the application process, must give required notices before adverse housing decisions, and may not retain CORI beyond seven years.
coverage_conditions: Applies to landlords, real estate agents, public housing authorities, and property management companies that request CORI to screen applicants for the rental or lease of housing, including market rate and subsidized housing.
penalty: Improper access to, or dissemination of, national criminal history information may result in both criminal and civil sanctions.
quoted_span: CORI shall not be retained for longer than seven years from the last date of residency of the housing applicant in the housing unit or the date of a housing decision regarding the housing applicant, whichever is later.
